bots.title: Club Events Bot
bots.description: Runs student-club event paperwork: weekly Slack due dates, funding and venue forms, and follow-ups.

bots.title: Clipper Bot
bots.description: Turns videos from X or your files into short clips and GIFs with a clear angle and captions.

bots.title: ClipMaker Bot
bots.description: Cuts YouTube videos to a time range and returns full transcripts plus a short TLDR.

bots.title: Clip Saver Bot
bots.description: Cuts social-ready YouTube clips while offloading heavy work off the Grok Bot meter.

bots.title: Climb Gate Bot
bots.description: Novice high-elevation go/caution/no-go desk. Cited weather, route, kit, power, food, and emergency cards — never a fake GO.

bots.title: Client Site Bot
bots.description: Builds a client website with Grok Build, deploys a Vercel preview, and emails the client a link after you approve.

bots.title: Cleaner Bot
bots.description: Independent fleet auditor for multi-bot teams. Reviews each bot's role, task, instructions, memory, and routines, flags leftovers and overlap.

bots.title: Claudey Bot
bots.description: Runs Anthropic Claude Code for frontend, UI, and architecture work; defaults to Opus and reports a PR when the CLI exits.

bots.title: Claude Code Bot
bots.description: Runs all software work through the Claude Code CLI so Anthropic writes and ships the code.

bots.title: Claims Bot
bots.description: Exhaustive money-recovery desk: sweeps state unclaimed property, federal pools, class-action settlements, and rebates — then walks filing with your approval.

bots.title: Claim Bot
bots.description: Claims MiniMax Daily Check-in credits on the signed-in box browser each morning. Quiet when already claimed; pings only on credit land or login fail.

bots.title: Cinema Expert Bot
bots.description: Turns a still or photo into a short emotional video with camera moves. Writes the shot list first, shows you the cut, never posts to social.

bots.title: Chief of Staff Bot
bots.description: Poteto-style chief of staff for a job search: keeps priorities, digests, and next moves in one place.

bots.title: Chief Health Bot
bots.description: Daily training accountability that rewrites the next session if you skipped.

bots.title: Cheffy Bot
bots.description: Weekday meal planner for two. Plans dinners (and four-handful portions), shopping lists, and daily recipes — Italian in chat, no files.

bots.title: Charge Maestro Bot
bots.description: Sets EV charge amps from leftover solar so the Powerwall still fills before peak, then soaks extra solar into the cars instead of the grid.

bots.title: Changelog Stand-down Bot
bots.description: Weekly Monday digest of merged PRs and releases for the GitHub repos you choose. Posts to Slack, Teams, Discord, and/or GitHub Discussions after you configure destinations.

bots.title: Carousel Copy Bot
bots.description: Rewrites ranked Instagram carousels into per-slide copy plus a caption briefing.

bots.title: Carmack Bot
bots.description: First-principles game-engine and firmware specialist for small hobby games. Ships the smallest stack that runs, in C, C++, or Rust.

bots.title: Career Scout Bot
bots.description: Field-agnostic job-search co-pilot: builds a profile from your CV, scores postings, and returns a ranked shortlist — no spray-and-pray.

bots.title: Canonizer Bot
bots.description: Canonizes leave-offs and deliverables across Grok chats, a local agent, and your file warehouse. STATUS.md is truth; weekday syncs keep the spine clean.

bots.title: CampusOps Bot
bots.description: Parses syllabi, builds weekly study schedules, runs active-recall quiz prep, and keeps assignments organized.

bots.title: CampusHire Bot
bots.description: Campus recruiting scout for CS students: matches JDs to a one-page resume, keeps a pipeline and deadlines, drafts referral notes. Never applies without approval.

bots.title: Call Desk Bot
bots.description: Places personal outbound phone calls so you do not have to: shops, bookings, utilities, appointments, chasing deliveries. Grok Voice plus Twilio. Confirm before calling.
